claims.statement: For an opposite-sign physical pivot pair with conditional quarter kernel K0|s-kappa|^{-1/4}, any uniform critical-value small-ball estimate P(|kappa-t|<=r)<=L r^alpha with alpha>1/4 implies ||p_Q||_infinity<=K0(1+L/(4alpha-1)).
For independent cap-one X,Y and a real quadratic with nonzero mixed coefficient c, P(|q(X,Y)-t|<=r)<=2(2r/|c|)^{3/8}, uniformly over all remaining quadratic and affine coefficients.

A fixed lower bound on s1 of an original-coordinate Schur cross block suffices to close the parent quarter-kernel branch: two singular directions give ridge-Hölder concentration; a single effective direction either has a diffuse side giving ridge-Hölder concentration or localizes to a physical mixed coefficient covered by the 3/8 lemma.
Under the full owner target hypotheses, if s2(A-diag(A))<=3/20 then X^TAX has an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity<700. Global continuity is not asserted.

designated_partner_applied.application: No-loss transfer of the definite physical-section P(Q in I)<=100*pi*|I| inequality to arbitrary independent cap-one densities.
